hypothesis: Exact rig round and artifact binding eliminates stale or cross-paired energy evidence without changing valid retention decisions.
target_metric: named provenance tamper cases rejected before retention
expected_user_value: Energy comparisons cannot silently cherry-pick rounds or detach measurements from the image and kernel that produced them.
freeze_note: The initial evaluator froze five tamper classes before any candidate. Independent review identified decision-count and scope as two more fields emitted by the same rig round. The candidate was restored to the exact parent, the expanded seven-class evaluator was run and frozen at evaluator_sha256, and only then was the expanded candidate applied.
invariants: Eleven pair, 1.10 median gain and lower confidence bound gates unchanged
Model, quantization, kernel arithmetic and compiler flags unchanged
Every energy report covers one exact rig round and named arm
Execution, hardware flag, model, target, kernel, image, decision count and scope match the rig report
No physical energy or performance claim without traces and boards
